# The jackpot gem: a mint six-sided crystal 0.5 m across, 0.43 m tall, a pale table on top. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Gem --base-color 0.0471 0.9059 0.6549 --no-slot
material new Facet --base-color 0.6745 0.9882 0.6784 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name Low --vertices 6 --radius1 0.02 --radius2 0.25 --depth 0.26 --location 0.000 0.000 0.130
material assign Gem
add mesh cone --name High --vertices 6 --radius1 0.25 --radius2 0.13 --depth 0.17 --location 0.000 0.000 0.345
material assign Gem
active High
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Facet
mode object
active Low
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select all
shade flat
export gem.glb
